comment: How the archer sounds. Format: core/CueSystem.h. Events: ApplicationArcher::SignalCues. Edited while the game runs, it reloads within a second. Moved here from hand-wired code on 2026-09-27 (cue_plan.md step 3) and checked against recordings/*.cues with tools/cue_replay.py - after a deliberate change, re-baseline with --write.

her.comment: Her voice, breathing included: one sound at a time. PRIORITY decides who gives way (vitals_plan.md section 6): 2 a grunt of pain, 1 a shout or a line, 0 a breath. A higher one cuts a lower one (busy interrupt); an equal or lower one arriving while she speaks is skipped - so a breath never plays over a huh, and a kick in the air right after a jump's huh stays quiet. gap is ticks of silence after a line, if she ever comments too much.

effects.comment: everything that is not her voice or, later, the narrator and the music

ambience.comment: loops of the place - the waterfall so far; the range, wind and birds later

body.comment: her heartbeat - not her voice, so it overlaps everything, and has its own fader

bow_tension.comment: The creak starts on the NOCK, not the press - the first ticks of a draw are her reaching back to the quiver with the string slack. Cut the moment the string goes, by whatever ends the draw.

arrow_leave.comment: Louder the harder the draw: a half-drawn lob leaves the string with far less in it.

arrow_swoosh.comment: Timed so its loudest moment lands on the impact the flight forecasts; started partway in when the impact is nearer than its lead. Once per flight.

arrow_hit.comment: By speed, so a spent arrow dropping onto the grass is a tap and a full-draw shot into a crate is a thud; and by distance from her - on screen (12) is full volume, fading to a floor of 0.15. 46 is ARROW_SPEED_MAX. PANNED by where it lands against her: the view is about 32 units wide, so the screen's edge is 16 away, and 0.6 there keeps an off-screen hit in both ears rather than in one.

kick_swing.comment: The leg going out, heard whether or not it finds anything: kick tick 11 on K's kick (delay 10 from tick 1), and the other kicks moved with their own strike (strike_shift).

kick_land.comment: The boot hitting something - on the connect and nothing else. Rings on after the kick.

kick_shout.comment: Her shout, on some kicks, on a tick that wanders: kick ticks 10..16, found by ear on kick_hyaa, the others moved so their loud parts land where its does. Never the same shout twice running. (Until 2026-09-27 this had seed 0 and no_repeat false, which reproduced the old hand-wired draws for the step 3 proof.)

jump_takeoff.comment: The push off the ground, on the tick she leaves it.

jump_voice.comment: Her effort on a jump, the way she shouts on a kick: on some jumps (chance), on a tick that wanders a little (jitter), and each file moved so its loud part lands where jump_huh_1's does - which is why that one is first, being the latest to peak (9.6 ticks in; huh_2 7.2, ha 6.6). The loud part comes about a sixth of a second into the rise.

jump_landing.comment: Feet meeting the ground. The file builds for 0.13 s to its thud, so it starts that far AHEAD of the touchdown on the landing forecast (landing_ahead, like the arrow's swoosh) and the thud lands on the contact tick. Once per flight. Nothing under 5, which is a step off a kerb, not a landing (PUPPET_LAND_VEL); louder the harder she comes down, full at 25, where the hard landing starts.

land_grunt.comment: A hard landing - 25 and over, where the animation's hard landing starts (PUPPET_HARD_LAND_VEL) - knocks a grunt out of her, just after the impact rather than on it.

footstep.comment: A foot planting in the walk or run on screen (ApplicationArcher::SignalFootsteps - measured toe plants, so it stays on the foot at any speed). One of four, never the same twice running; softer at a walk than a sprint (9 is ARCHER_RUN_SPEED). The files are quiet already, about 20 dB under the kick, so gain 1 is not loud. gap 4 guards against a double step at a clip handover.

nice_shot.comment: The centre ring of a stand, and only that: she says so.

breath_in.comment: Her breathing (vitals_plan.md): ApplicationArcher::SignalBody clocks one breath at a time off her exertion - every 4 s rested to 1.35 s spent, on her footsteps while she runs, restarted by a jump or a kick. Silent until she has worked a little (0.15; a walk never gets there, a jog does in a few seconds), then louder the harder she breathes. The lowest priority in her group: any line she says cuts it, and it waits for none.

breath_out.comment: The second half of the breath, 28 ticks after breath_in - past the longest in-breath, so it never finds her busy with her own.

heartbeat.comment: Her heart, at her heart rate (ApplicationArcher::SignalBody). HEARD FROM FEAR: pound is her fear, or the far end of her exertion (past 0.8), so a racing heart after a sprint is not heard until she is spent. The two files alternate. The lub to dub is 0.28 s, so past about 130 bpm a beat runs into the next - that is her heart at its most afraid. Not in her group: it overlaps everything.

land_shake.comment: FEEL, not sound (cue_plan.md step 4). A drop shakes the view down and thumps the pad; an ordinary jump does not - it lands at about 18.7, so this starts at 20 and is full by 34, the fastest she can fall. Mostly vertical. shake: amount is trauma added (0..1, the view moves by its square), axes [across, up]; rumble: low and high motor 0..1. Both scaled by gain_by. The camera's shake sliders say how big a full shake is.

kick_shake.comment: The boot finding something: a short jolt along the kick, and a sharp buzz in the light motor.

wall_shake.comment: A wall coming apart - the biggest thing she can do to the level, so the biggest shake. More bricks, more of it.

vine_grow.comment: A vine arrow's plant starting to grow - a hanging vine from an underside or a creeper up a wall (vine_plan.md steps 5 and 8). The user's own sound, 3.3 s against the vine's 2.5 s of growth, so it tails off as the leaves open. By distance and panned, like the arrow's hit; a longer vine a little louder.

bamboo_grow.comment: A bamboo arrow's clump shooting up (vine_plan.md step 8b). 3.5 s against 1.25 s of growth: the canes are up fast and the sound carries on past them. As the vine's otherwise; taller canes a little louder.

roots_grow.comment: Roots alone, out of an underside or a wall: every normal arrow into one, so this is heard more than any other growth and kept quieter. The roots under a vine or a bamboo clump are covered by that plant's own sound and never signal this. A tuft alone is silent.

waterfall.comment: The bay's waterfall (water_plan.md), looping while she is in earshot - ApplicationArcher::SignalCues opens a `waterfall` scope within 40 of it, with its x. Loudest within 4 of it and gone by 36, before the scope closes; panned by which side of it she is, never hard over - it is a wide thing, heard with both ears. Both follow her as she moves.
